messages:
olivia: Quick sync — planning a staggered deploy tonight 01:00 UTC for api -> runtime -> console -> router. Need pins, rollback criteria, release notes, and the deploy-bot wave. Who's owning cross-service handshake?
marc: I can own API side. Will pin v2.14.0 and add canary flag.
anya: I’ll do runtime. Thinking of enabling kernel batching toggle behind a feature flag. Pin runtime to commit 9a3f4d.
sre-oncall: Heads up — quiet window is 00:30–02:30 UTC. Need to avoid shard rebalances during that time.
olivia: @marc can you confirm API compatibility matrix with runtime change? We can only bump runtime if router and console remain backward compatible.
marc: API contract unchanged. Runtime change is internal perf-only. But runtime team should publish a smoke test for router binary compatibility.
kevin: I’ll run router smoke tests. Will need a pinned kernel build: router@1.8.2.
lisa: Console will be a no-op for this deploy but we need release notes and a rollout flag so support can toggle if something odd appears.
olivia: Good. Rollback policy suggestion: 10% traffic canary for 15 mins, if error rate > 1.5x baseline then automatic rollback. Manual rollback criteria: P50 latency regression > 50ms for 5m, or 5xx spike > 0.5% of requests. Thoughts?
sre-oncall: Sounds fine. Add a circuit-breaker to fallback to previous model if KV cache warms fail.
marc: Agree on canary. For API pinning: I'll set version header and route 10% to v2.14.0 via deploy-bot.
anya: Runtime: enable batching after KV cache warm — add healthcheck endpoint exposed to deploy-bot: /_health?warm=true
marc: Can deploy-bot run the warm check and then flip traffic?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduling wave ALPHA at 2026-04-01T01:00:00Z, targets: api:v2.14.0, runtime:9a3f4d, console:unchanged, router:1.8.2. Canary 10% for 15m. Pre-hooks: smoke-test-router, runtime-warmcheck. Post-hooks: telemetry-sanity-check.
kevin: Received. I added a quick smoke test: ``curl -sS https://router-smoke/_check | grep OK``
lisa: Release notes draft: "Performance: runtime batching and kernel selection improvements reduce median token latency ~18% for short seqs. No API changes. Rollout: staggered canary. Rollback: automatic on elevated errors." I'll drop in the release-notes doc.
olivia: Add explicit rollback owner list: API: marc, Runtime: anya, Router: kevin, Console: lisa, SRE: sre-oncall.
sre-oncall: I'll monitor and can trigger cluster-level failover. Also add runbook link before deploy: https://confluence/infra/runbooks/deploy-staggered
marc: One more: pin database migration flag to off — we are not running migrations. Confirmed.
anya: I'll add runtime env var RUNTIME_BATCHING=auto and feature flag runtime.batch.enabled=false initially, deploy-bot will flip to true post-warm.
olivia: Okay next steps: marc pins API + config; anya pins runtime + healthcheck; kevin pins router + smoke; lisa finalizes release notes and support blurb; sre-oncall prepares alert thresholds and dashboard. Deploy-bot to run prehooks then canary.
marc: Working on pin now, pushing tag.
kevin: Router smoke test added to deploy-bot hooks.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Prehooks completed: smoke-test-router OK, runtime-warmcheck OK. Initiating canary traffic shift to 10%.
kevin: Seeing 10% traffic routed, no errors in the smoke window.
marc: API metrics look clean. p50 +10ms, 5xx none.
anya: Runtime memory stable, batching queue depth nominal.
sre-oncall: Telemetry sanity passed. No alarms. Proceed to gradual ramp plan?
olivia: Proceed to 50% in 10 minutes, monitor. If anything trips, rollback immediately to previous pins.
lisa: Publishing release notes and pinging support.
marc: Noted. Oncall ready.
kevin: Router ready to rollback if needed.
anya: If we rollback, I'll flip runtime.flag runtime.batch.enabled back to false and clear KV cache.
sre-oncall: I'm watching dashboards and will escalate on anomalies.
marc: 50% shift in progress.
marc: 100% complete. No regressions observed after 30m.
olivia: Great work team. Summary: deploy completed, pins recorded: api:v2.14.0, runtime:9a3f4d, router:1.8.2. Rollback not required. I'll update release notes with final metrics and close the deploy thread. :tada:
